text: The purpose of this staff report is to seek City Council approval of 1 Yonge Street Public Art Plan. The Plan, which is included as Attachment 1 of this report, outlines the method by which the owner will commission public art adjacent to the corner plaza which is publicly owned. The Public Art Plan provides a framework and description of the commissioning of public art including: introduction and background; project team; reference to the Section 37 agreement; public art objectives; mentorship opportunity; maps and renderings; public art north contribution location; public art south contribution location; budget; selection process; jury composition and schedule. The attached plan meets the objectives of the City Planning's Percent for Public Art Guidelines and is supported by the Toronto Public Art Commission.

City Council on March 10, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the 1 Yonge Street Public Art Plan attached as Attachment 1 to the report (January 25, 2021) from the Director, Urban Design.
